subject: general
question: Al- Biruni, the Persian scholar, accompanied which invader to Afghanistan and India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahmud Ghazni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Al-Biruni**

 
 
• **He was the Persian scholar who accompanied Mahmud Ghaznavi to Afghanistan and India.**
 
• His celebrated works are Kitab-ul-Hind and Tahkeek-e- Hind.
 
• It is notable that famous scholars Utbi and Firdausi were also in the court of Mahmud Ghaznavi.
 
• **Al-Biruni was born in 973 AD at Kath, the capital of the Afrighid dynasty of Khwarezm in Central Asia, in the Khiza area (Uzbekistan).**
 
• **He spent much of his life in Ghazni, the capital of the Ghaznavids in modern-day central-eastern Afghanistan and visited India in 1017. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• He studied **Islamic jurisprudence, theology, language, mathematics, astronomy, medicine, philosophy**, and most other sciences throughout the first twenty-five years of his life in Khwarezm.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• He was a gifted linguist, fluent in Khwarezmian, Persian, Arabic, and Sanskrit, as well as Greek, Hebrew, and Syriac.
 
• Most academics, including Al-Biruni, were brought to **Ghazni**, the capital of the Ghaznavid dynasty, in AD 1017, when **Mahmud of Ghazni** was the monarch.
 
• **In the 11th century**, Abu al-Rayhan Muhammad was designated a royal astrologer and accompanied Mahmud of Ghazni on his incursions into India (most likely in Punjab), where he lived for a few years. (Alberuni was 44 years old when he accompanied Mahmud of Ghazni to India).
 
• He was** fascinated by Indian culture and studied Sanskrit, Indian philosophy**, and the country's socio-economic situation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahmud of Ghazni (971 to 1030)**

 
 
• **A Turkish family called Gamini of the Ghaznavid dynasty ruled Ghazni in Afghanistan.**
 
• He was the **first Turkish who invaded India.**
 
• He attacked India only for wealth.
 
• He attacked India seventeen times between 1000 and 1027 AD.
 
• In 1001 A.D. he made his first invasion of India.
 
• **Mahmud’s most important expedition in India was against the Somnath temple in 1025 A.D.**, located on the coast of Kathiawar, Gujrat. Raja Bhima Dev the ruler of Kathiawar and his followers escaped from the place for the fear of Mahmud.
